verify_detail: SHIP\nThe one thing this app does is count pings, and it has demonstrated, on this exact build, that it can silently drop hundreds of counted pings without any crash or user-visible error. That\'s a correctness failure in the app\'s core feature. I\'d block release until the counter persistence path is fixed and covered by a regression test that simulates the binder/IPC failure path, and until the "about"/"diagnostics" navigation is either confirmed reachable or removed from the release build.'
